messages:
Samir Khatri: PSA: release-train update — embargo + cadence adjustment for the big model rollout. Effective Thu 08:00 UTC -> Mon 08:00 UTC. Full freeze for non-urgent changes touching model weights, cross-region syncs, storage layer, or routing rules. Allow: security fixes, urgent hotpatches (PD approval), telemetry flags. Reason: cross-region weights sync + planned network maintenance across EU/APAC.

Jen Park: Noted. Will teams still be able to merge docs/README updates and small frontend tweaks that don't touch the API surface?

Samir Khatri: Yes, non-code docs + client-side UI copy that does not change request shapes or routes are OK. Anything touching model config, quantization profiles, or routing needs an exemption.

Alex Mora: Infra note 1: during the last rollout we had a subtle drift in KV connection counts during the weights sync which caused p99 spikes. For the embargo window I'll stagger syncs region-by-region and add a temporary circuit-breaker on cross-region traffic. Provisioning +2 g4 pools per region during the top-up window.

ops-bot: Heads-up: automated traffic shaping will enable the cross-region circuit-breaker at Thu 08:30 UTC. Ops page: /ops/runbooks/weights-sync.

deploy-bot: Policy: PRs labeled `deploy:embargo-frozen` will be blocked. Use `deploy:emergency` AND PD approval for hotpatch exceptions. CI will comment with exemption instructions.

Lina Gomez: I'll notify integrators and external partners. ETA on status page banner?

Samir Khatri: I'll post the banner and a short FAQ within 30 minutes. Lina — please add a partner note with recommended retry/backoff guidance.

Jen Park: Adding rollout rollback criteria here: auto-rollback if error rate > 0.4% OR p95 > baseline +300ms sustained 5m OR cross-region sync failures > 2 in 10m. Oncall must ack before any manual continue.

Maya Rivera (oncall): I'll mirror these conditions into the alerting rules and add a temporary escalation path to the release leads rota. If anything fires I'll page #release-leads and flip the deployment to halt.

Alex Mora: Quick debug commands for oncall:
```bash
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=weight-sync --since=15m | egrep "sync fail|timeout|connection reset" -A3
kubectl -n prod top pods -l app=embedder
```
Artifacts: s3://ops-artifacts/weights-rollout/2026-03-23/ (retained 14d).

Samir Khatri: Proposed cadence tweak: next two weeks we'll freeze scheduled canaries on Wednesdays to avoid overlapping with the embargo. We'll revert to normal cadence after rollout. Thumbs-up if you accept. :thumbsup:

Jen Park: +1 1 will update release calendar and product comms.

Lina Gomez: +1 from partner comms. I'll coordinate a short post-mortem template to capture any partner impacts.

Alex Mora: +1. Will attach region-specific dashboards to the runbook.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: status posts every 4h to this thread until embargo lifts.

Samir Khatri: Thanks everyone. I'll compose a short exec note summarizing the embargo, expected impact, and escalation contacts. Will update if lift timeline changes.
